## What changes

One or two sentences. Link the issue if there is one.

## Evidence

- [ ] `node tools/test.mjs --check-inventory` passes
- [ ] `node tools/test.mjs` passes (portable and performance)
- [ ] `node tools/build-codebase-guide.mjs --write` run if source changed
- [ ] Browser lane or manual check, if the change affects behavior in Chrome

Say what kind of evidence you have: Node suite with mocks, source assertion,
real Chrome run, or manual check.

## Checklist

- [ ] No database names, stored keys, discriminators or file-format fields renamed
- [ ] No page URLs, titles or user text in logs
- [ ] UI copy is short, concrete, international English, no em dashes
- [ ] Contribution is submitted under MPL-2.0 (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
